connector.name: Homebox MCP
connector.registryDescription: Homebox home inventory: search, intake, warranties, attachments, locations, tags, QR labels
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package homebox-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dgahagan account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HOMEBOX_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Homebox instance (>= 0.26), e.g. https://homebox.example.com

env.name: HOMEBOX_TOKEN
env.description: Homebox API key (Profile -> API Keys, starts with hb_)

env.name: HOMEBOX_ALIAS_FIELD
env.description: Optional: name of one custom field treated as a stable item identifier for lookups

env.name: HOMEBOX_LABEL_DIR
env.description: Optional: directory where label/QR PNGs are saved (default: current directory)
